title: Build a CLI dashboard for experiment results from results.tsv
description:
The existing analysis.ipynb notebook requires Jupyter to view results. Add a standalone CLI script (results_dashboard.py) that renders a rich terminal dashboard from results.tsv, usable over SSH without a GUI.

The dashboard must display:
  1. Summary banner: total experiments, best val_bpb, baseline val_bpb, total improvement, improvement %
  2. Per-run table: commit, val_bpb, memory_gb, status (color-coded: keep=green, discard=yellow, crash=red), description
  3. Running best (frontier) line: show the val_bpb of the best kept run at each row
  4. A sparkline of val_bpb over time (ASCII, shows kept runs only)
  5. Session statistics: keep rate, crash rate, average val_bpb delta per kept experiment

Technical constraints:
  - No new dependencies. Must work with only Python stdlib and what's already in pyproject.toml
  - Must handle empty results.tsv gracefully (print 'No results yet')
  - Must handle malformed rows (skip with a warning)
  - Works correctly when results.tsv has only a header row
  - Optional --tail N flag: show only the last N experiments (useful for long runs)
  - Optional --kept-only flag: show only 'keep' status rows
acceptance_criteria: results_dashboard.py runs with no extra dependencies (stdlib + pyproject.toml only)
Displays summary banner with baseline, best, improvement statistics
Per-run table with color-coded status (green/yellow/red via ANSI codes)
Running best column shows frontier val_bpb at each row
ASCII sparkline of val_bpb over time for kept runs
Handles empty file and header-only file gracefully
Skips malformed rows with a stderr warning
